title: Evidence-Aware MapReduce for Forkable Compute
abstract: arXiv:2607.09689v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Snapshot-backed sandboxes make branching cheap while leaving evidence dependence unchanged. Branches can reuse a model, prompt, repository, tests, observations, or execution ancestor, so counting outputs can amplify one repeated error into high-confidence consensus. We introduce an \emph{evidence-aware reduction contract}: each worker reports an estimate, estimated information, evidence identifiers, fork lineage, and execution metadata. For independent workers estimating one common parameter, we use standard inverse-information pooling in its Gaussian/Wald form. The fixed-dimensional numeric summary can merge in any tree order; evidence IDs and lineage follow separate rules. The residual $\Delta$ measures disagreement, becomes Cochran's $Q$ in the scalar inverse-variance case, and appears in the product integral. A reference implementation validates serialized records, rejects repeated nonempty evidence identifiers, carries evidence

translated_title: 证据感知的MapReduce用于可分叉计算
translated_abstract: 快照支持的沙箱使得分支变得廉价，同时保持证据依赖性不变。分支可以复用模型、提示、仓库、测试、观察或执行祖先，因此计数输出可以将一个重复错误放大为高置信度的共识。我们引入了一种“证据感知的归约契约”：每个工作节点报告估计值、估计信息、证据标识符、分叉谱系和执行元数据。对于估计一个共同参数的独立工作节点，我们使用高斯/瓦尔德形式的标准逆信息池化。固定维度的数值摘要可以在任意树顺序中合并；证据ID和谱系遵循单独的规则。残差$\Delta$衡量分歧，在标量逆方差情况下变为Cochran的$Q$，并出现在乘积积分中。一个参考实现验证了序列化记录，拒绝重复的非空证据标识符，并携带证据。
tldr: 本文提出了一种证据感知的MapReduce归约契约，通过跟踪证据标识符和分叉谱系来防止重复错误在可分叉计算中被放大为虚假共识。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an evidence-aware reduction contract for MapReduce that tracks evidence identifiers and fork lineage to prevent repeated errors from being amplified into false consensus in forkable compute.
